plan.title: What changed
items: You said none of 1A, 1B or 1C land: they felt like narrative made to move the story on. Your new setup is draft 1D, in your words.
1E is the same setup cut to the bone, in case 1D drags.

plan.title: Why this works where the others did not
items: Nobody is talked round on screen. Maddie apologises, takes the shout, leaves the evidence and goes. The humans decide for their own reasons (the bunker, Derek, the food), so it reads like people, not plot.
We leave on the vote starting; the next day is the answer.
